description:
- Fast content search tool for project codebases of any size
- Searches file contents using regular expressions
- Supports full regex syntax (eg. "TODO|FIXME", "class\\s+\\w+", "on[A-Z]\\w+")
- Filter files by pattern with the include parameter (eg. "*.ts", "src/**/*.rs")
- By default, skips root-level generated, cache, log, and build directories
- Returns file paths and line numbers with at least one match sorted by path and line number
- Returned paths are relative to the workspace root (files outside the workspace are absolute), so they can be passed directly to read/edit
- You MUST set path explicitly; never rely on the current process directory
- Matches raw text only: results include comments, strings, and docs; identifier hits are not semantic symbol references
- On very broad patterns the search may stop early and return an incomplete, non-deterministic subset (the result says so explicitly); narrow pattern/path/include for complete, stable results

pattern.description: The regex pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: The directory to search in. Required.

include.description: File pattern to include in the search (e.g. "*.ts", "src/**/*.rs")
